title: Plugin Loading Workflow
activity_flow: CHECK: arePluginsDisabled('local') → if false: getLocalRepository() → loadRepository(repo, false, rootPackage)
CHECK: globalComposer != null AND arePluginsDisabled('global') → if false: loadRepository(globalRepo, true)
GUARD: skip if type not in [composer-plugin, composer-installer]
GUARD (local only): if not in requiredPackages AND NOT isPluginAllowed(name, false, true, false) → warn + skip
→ CHECK arePluginsDisabled → if disabled: writeError warning + RETURN
→ check API version compatibility: if mismatch → warn + RETURN
→ CALL isPluginAllowed(name, isGlobalPlugin, optional) → if not allowed: debug log + RETURN
→ CHECK already registered → if yes: RETURN (idempotent)
→ READ extra['class'] from package; throw if empty
→ BUILD autoload: collectDependencies() → parseAutoloads() → createLoader() → classLoader.register()
→ LOAD files autoload entries (skip laminas bridge hack)
→ if class already exists: rename with _composer_tmp{counter} via eval()
→ validate implements InstallerInterface; throw if not
→ validate implements PluginInterface; throw if not
→ CALL isPluginAllowed(sourcePackage.name, isGlobalPlugin, optional) → if not allowed: debug log + RETURN
→ if rules == null (legacy lock file): if !interactive → throw RuntimeException; else rules = []
→ FOREACH pattern in rules: if Preg::isMatch(pattern, package) → return allow
→ if interactive AND prompt: ask user y/n/d/?
→ y: persist to allow-plugins in composer.json; return true
→ n: persist as disallowed; return false
→ CHECK arePluginsDisabled + get repos → deactivateRepository(repo, isGlobalRepo)
→ FOREACH package: if composer-plugin or composer-installer → deactivatePackage(package)
→ find plugin index in plugins[] (strict); if not found: RETURN
key_relationships: PluginManager uses RepositoryUtils::filterRequiredPackages (static, local repos only)
PluginManager checks if plugin implements Capable to get capabilities via getCapabilities()
PluginManager checks if plugin implements EventSubscriberInterface → eventDispatcher.addSubscriber()
PluginManager uses AutoloadGenerator::parseAutoloads + createLoader for plugin class loading
CommandProvider extends Capability; returns BaseCommand[] via getCommands()
PluginManager::getPluginCapabilities() iterates active plugins and calls getPluginCapability()
PluginManager throws PluginBlockedException when plugin not in allow-plugins config
key_decision_points: arePluginsDisabled(local|global) — skips local or global loading entirely
API version compatibility check (composer-plugin-api semver constraint)
isPluginAllowed — matches against allow-plugins patterns; may prompt interactively
Already registered check — prevents double-loading (idempotent guard)
Class already exists at load time — rename with _composer_tmp{N} to avoid collision
oldInstallerPlugin (composer-installer legacy type) — registers as Installer not Plugin
failOnMissingClasses flag — controls whether missing class is silently skipped or throws
error_paths: API version mismatch → warn + skip (no exception)
Plugin not in allow-plugins (optional) → silently skip (return false)
Class not implementing PluginInterface or InstallerInterface → RuntimeException
important_notes: PLUGIN_API_VERSION = '2.9.0'. allow-plugins config can be true (allow all), false (block all), or map of package-pattern → bool. Rules are regex patterns from package name globs. Legacy lock files (pre-2.2) have null rules — interactive mode prompts, non-interactive throws. classCounter is static to avoid class name collision across multiple loads. Capability system: plugins implementing Capable can expose CommandProvider (returns BaseCommand[]) and other capability interfaces.
